business_problem: Glassdoor needed Fishbowl to scale search and content discovery for rapid user growth while eliminating the sync complexity and stale results created by a separate Elasticsearch stack.
solution_summary: Fishbowl, Glassdoor's professional social network, standardized on MongoDB Atlas on AWS to store its growing corpus of workplace conversations and then replaced Elasticsearch with MongoDB Atlas Search. Atlas matched the application's document-oriented data model and gave the team easier scaling and monitoring as the service grew to more than one million active users and 23 million comments. By moving search onto the Atlas cluster, the team removed a separate sync pipeline that previously pushed data into Elasticsearch and sometimes left moderated content visible as stale results. Atlas Search now powers category scans, fuzzy search, faster reindexing, and future personalization work while reducing operational overhead and freeing engineers to ship user-facing improvements more quickly.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores Fishbowl conversation and company data on AWS and provides the managed document database foundation for the application.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Search
solution_components.role: Indexes the same Atlas data to power relevance ranking, fuzzy search, categorization, and faster reindexing without a separate search stack.

data_flow: User posts, comments, and company content are written to MongoDB Atlas on AWS, Atlas Search indexes that same cluster data, and Fishbowl and Glassdoor applications query the index to return relevant content, categories, and typo-tolerant results to users.
business_outcome: Glassdoor improved search reliability, reduced operational overhead, sped up reindexing from days to minutes, and created a stronger foundation for personalized content experiences across Fishbowl and Glassdoor.
metrics: Glassdoor has more than 59 million unique monthly web visitors.
Fishbowl has more than one million active users.
Fishbowl has 23 million comments across four million posts.
With Atlas Search, reindexing content now takes 5-10 minutes instead of days.
architecture_clues: Atlas Search is colocated on Atlas clusters, removing the need for a separate search-sync mechanism.
The previous Elasticsearch architecture could surface stale moderated content when sync issues occurred.
The team plans to use MongoDB to personalize the news feed as the platform matures.
